A ayarlarını sakla; ayarları değiştirip: Save settings A; change the settings and save B. The same microphone recording is converted with both settings. Live conversion pauses during this operation.

Alan seçip sağ tıkla. Kaydet bütün düzen: Select a region and right-click. Save keeps the entire edit; to keep only the selection, use “Delete outside selection”. The source file is preserved.
Alanı seçip bir tuşa veya kombinasyona b: Select a field and press a key or combination; its Save button activates only that binding. Numpad keys are distinguished from top-row numbers. Backspace clears the binding.

Bağlantı kurulamadı; son kaydedilen list: Connection failed; showing the last saved list.
Başlangıç, dönüşüm ve hata mesajları bur: Startup, conversion and error messages appear here. The full session log is in the local user log folder.

CPU üzerinde yerel çalışır. Yaklaşık 30: Runs locally on the CPU. Adds about 30 ms of buffering latency. The speech gate is off by default; a high threshold may cut off quiet speech.
Canlı RVC sesinde AP-BWE’yi etkinleştir: Enable AP-BWE for Live RVC Audio
